lines.en: We cut to the interior of the Kanda family apartment several hours later — where both Kanda daughters are seated in different positions on the couch, meant to emphasize their respective mental states.

The youngest daughter was wide open, the way she always is. Her feet dangled in the air like the hands of a corpse hanging off the twin-size bed of a necrophiliac deep in the act of persistent postmortem coitus.

Her sister, on the other hand, took up a more reserved posture — hugging her knees with both arms in a way that didn’t just allow her to use them as a pillow, but made her feel more comfortable and protected.
She didn’t think her little sister was going to rape her, though — so she wasn’t really sure just what she was protecting herself from at the moment.

Thoughts, perhaps? Did she fear that the man she encountered earlier would return after misinterpreting her final line? No. That was unlikely. She probably won’t see him again for another several weeks.
Yet she mourned his absence from the halls of her school. The way she used to look over her shoulder before turning every corner to try and spot him somewhere.
He’d seldom spot her back. In fact, she’d seldom spot him at all. But every time she did, it made her heart skip a beat. And it still skipped some nights, but she hated that it did that.
She hated that it did that, and she hated it because it meant she was right about something. She was right about how some things are too good to be true, and he was always one of them.

He wasn’t kind or caring. He wasn’t attentive. He didn’t like the things she did and had spent way too much time with the other girl on the couch. There was never really anything good about him at all.
His flaws were so evident now — and all it took was a brush with death to pry the blindness from her eyes and change everything.
She wished it would all change back, though. And somewhere it did — but that somewhere was not here, for this wish had already been made.
And all that was left to do was sit here hugging her knees while waiting for the couch to swallow her whole.
: Is it just me, or is Tom Holland, like...weirdly hot?
: Hot? I didn’t think he’d be your type at all.
: I don’t really have a type. I see beauty in everyone, I think. Just, in his case, I want him to take me to his room and-
: Kirin, stop.
: Stop what? I was just gonna say “read me a bedtime story and pat my head.”
: Oh...Sorry.
: You’re usually more...abrasive than that.
: Everything okay? You’ve seemed a little off all night.
: You’re...actually asking?
: Yeah. I’m good Kirin now. I’ve decided to switch personalities.
: You can just...do that?
: It helps not having any idea what your identity is or even what you like. So you’d probably struggle with it.
: Mm...darn it. That’s exactly what I want right now too.
: What do you mean? What could perfect, beautiful, wonderful Karin Kanda possibly want to change about herself?
: I wish I was less nice.
: Um...why?
: It makes me weak...
: I keep feeling bad about stuff I shouldn’t feel bad about and everything would be so much easier right now if I just...knew how to hold a grudge.
: I don’t want to be thinking about second chances. I want to just move on. But I keep second guessing myself and I just feel...like I’m doing the wrong thing when deep down, I know I’m not.
: I’m sorry if none of that made sense. I’m just really confused right now. But thank you for asking, Kirin. It helps.
: You know...this is kind of annoying.
: Yeah, I knew you wouldn’t like talking to me. But I’m grateful you tried anyway.
: Not that. Just you and Noriko are, like...weirdly identical when it comes to this whole “sit back and sulk” stuff. And it’s annoying because I wish you two would just do what you want for a change.
: But what I want is to not feel bad about being mean and every time I’m mean, I just...feel bad. Obviously.
: Then just don’t be mean. Problem solved. That sort of thing doesn’t fit you anyway.
: But if I’m not mean, how am I supposed to...keep people away from me?
: You coooould...file a restraining order?
: No...I’d rather keep this private. I don’t even want to get you involved. I just feel like I’m going to explode if I don’t try to talk about it, though.
: Well, you can tell me whatever you want. And I’m not going to, like...ridicule you or...get anyone else involved if that’s what you’re worried about.
: It’s not...but thank you again.
: Karin, chances are I probably already know what this is about right now. So if you just come out and say it-
: No.
: I just need to...stop being so weak...and stick to my guns.
: I always...think I’m doing a good job.
: But then every time I walk away, there’s this...feeling in my chest that, like...stays with me for the rest of the day. It spills into the next day too sometimes.
: And if that’s going to happen every single time, maybe it would make sense to just, like...stop caring about it?
: You know what would help with that?
: Please don’t say soup. It’ll only make things worse.
: A massage.
: That’s not soup at all.
: It’s certainly not.
: You can’t even eat that.
: Just let me rub your shoulders. I used to do it all the time at soccer practice. And I’m still new to this whole “caring” thing, so I’m not really sure what else to do for you right now.
: Will you really do that for me?
: Of course. I’d say you’ve earned it after being nothing but nice to me from the moment I was born.
: Then...okay.
: But if your hands get tired or you get bored and want to watch TV again-
: You know, this would be a really good opportunity for you to just shut up and stop trying to be so nice.
: But you’re my sister. I could never not be nice to-
: Aaaaah...
: Yup. Just like that. Can’t be nice if you’re lost in ecstasy.
: What was I...about to say again?...
: Something about how much you love your little sister, I think.
: Mmm.......yeaaaaah.......I love you, Kirin......
: I’m glad you’re......a good girl now.......I alwaaaays knew you......had it in youuuu......
: You’re a good girl too, Karin. Too good sometimes, as I’m sure you know. Which is why I think it’s cute that your main dilemma now is just “how can I be more mean?”
: It’s......something else, actually.......but......it can.....wait for another time......
: Yeah. But on the off chance you ever do want to open up a little more about it-
: Slower...
: On the off chance you ever do want to open up a little more about-
: Uhh...what was I...about to say?...
: Something I.......don’t want to......involve you in.....
: R-Right. Yeah. Tired. Sorry.
: You can stop if you want.....I don’t want to keep you awake if-
: I’m fine, okay? This isn’t about me, this is about you. And I’m going to help you relax no matter how I...have to do it...
: You’re doing great......already......
: That feels.....really good.....
: You...really...think so?
: M...hm....but you can...go a little harder...if...that’s okay...
: Harder...yeah...
: You mean like-
: Mm! Yes! Right there!
: (Screaming internally, horny, and ashamed)
: You really are.....good at this.....
: (Screaming internally, horny, ashamed, and happy)
: We should...do things like this...more often...
: You mean, like...t...touch...each other?
: Spend time...together...
: R-Right! Yes. Those are the words I meant to speak from my mouth.
: I feel like I...barely see you anymore...
: Ever since...the soccer club disbanded...it feels like you’ve been getting further...and further away...
: I miss you, Kirin...and I love you...
: I’m really happy you’re my-
: Kirin?
: Mhm?!
: Is everything okay?
: Mhm! Why?!
: Your face is beet red and you’re gritting your teeth.
: Let me feel your forehead. If you’re getting sick, I-
: No! Definitely not! I’m fine! No need to do that!
: Uhh...are you sure you’re-
: Yes!
: I just...um...t...totally forgot I still have homework to do, so-
: Go do that, then. That’s way more important than my problems.
: It’s...definitely not. But...
: It’s fine. I wanted to take another bath anyway. It’s easier for me to think in there.
: A bath...
: I can wait until you’re done with your homework if you want to take one together. We did it all the time when we were little. Do you re-
: Maaaaybe another time! Loooots of homeworks. Lots of...prooooblems. And words. Word...math problems...you know how it is!
: Do you want coffee? I can make-
: No thanks! I’m fine. Enjoy your bath!
: Huh...
: That was...weird.
: I’m sure it’s nothing, though!

Karin Kanda, who had never fantasized about having a sexual encounter with her little sister, found herself in the bath — continuing to not fantasize about having a sexual encounter with her little sister.
Unfortunately, though, she was merely one text box away from recollecting a sexual encounter she almost had with her teacher.
: Please...Sensei...don’t...
He was undeniably different that night. But the first thing on her mind was not to ask “Why?”
In fact, that wasn’t even in the top ten thoughts she’d think. It was buried somewhere beneath questions like “Am I going to live?” and “How much will this hurt?”
Even “Why didn’t I listen to my parents?” found its way in there. But “Why?” alone wasn’t something she’d ask until it all boiled over. Then again. And again. And again. Every day up to this one.
She always landed on a different answer, paying little mind to any excuse he’d try to come up with since she immediately distrusted him with every fiber of her being.
But there was one moment in the midst of all of that where she, still fearing for her life, couldn’t help but fear for his too — for she knew something had gone off in his mind.
It was just easier to believe that it was him realizing how wrong his actions were than anything else she could have come up with.
Maybe it really was an accident?
Could she go back to liking him if it was? Or did this single encounter completely destroy any opportunities she would have had to make such a terrible mistake in the future?
: Please don’t hurt me.
And just like that, he was back to normal.
: Do you ever dream of me?
She did.
: Sensei...
: You do...don’t you?
She does.
: Please...don’t do this...
: What am I like there? Inside of your head.
Kind. Gentle. Smart. Caring. Different. Only one of which was still true now.
: Is it better or worse than who I am on the outside?
Worse. A million times worse. And even that could not begin to describe it.
: And do you wish you could take me in?
Not like this.
That was the last thought she could remember thinking before everything went dark.
It was like her mind shut itself off as a means of self-preservation — creating an unfortunate save state that she’d be forced to look at every time she wanted to load up some other memory.
She kept coming back to this one, though...even when she didn’t want to.
Why?
Now was a more ideal time to ask such a question. Because as she gazed down at her reddening face reflecting off the water, she knew it wasn’t from the heat alone.

It was a million things. Curiosity. Hate. Lust. Betrayal. Admiration. Fear. Everything else — dumped into a blender and turned into a thick paste that tasted a little like lemon. Or maybe it was salt?
Either way, it was a flavor she’d only heard of before. One that she was excited to try one day when the time was right.
Yet she was plucked from mundanity like a lobster from a pot — just to be dumped back in when the chef noticed she was still wriggling.
She was thankful nothing happened.
At the same time though, at least she’d know what to think if something did.
Karin Kanda only touched herself once per month.
Almost always in the bath because it made her feel less dirty.
But tonight — it felt like she was bathing in shit.
She finished what she needed to do, then hung her head over the toilet for ten minutes before putting her clothes back on.
It wasn’t pretty.
None of this is.
Karin’s affection increases to [karin_love] because she’s naive and forgiving and you did this to her.
